subject: Execution scorecard: MAP, milestones & owner commitments (draft)
messages:
From: Jordan Reeves <jordan.reeves@orionlabs.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@orionlabs.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: kickoff follow-up — mutual plan and signoffs

Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Our execs liked the latency/cost profile and the Dedicated capacity option. Before we lock dates we need a clear, mutual action plan with milestones and named owners so our PMO can slot tasks into the program calendar.

High level asks from our side:
- Formal MAP with milestone dates through go-live (90 days)
- RACI for infra work, integrations, and validation
- Procurement timeline for PO and contract signature

Can your team send a draft scorecard we can review? Ideally it calls out the Redwood owners for each milestone and any anticipated blocker windows.

Jordan
Jordan Reeves
Head of Integrations, Orion Labs
jordan.reeves@orionlabs.com
(415) 555-0123
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Reeves <jordan.reeves@orionlabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Procurement Team <procure@orionlabs.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Execution scorecard: MAP, milestones & owner commitments (draft)
Attachments: Orion_MAP_draft.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Jordan — appreciate the clear asks. Attached is a compact execution scorecard (XLSX) that maps key milestones across a 90-day runway with named owners and acceptance criteria. Summary of what you'll find in the draft:

- Phase 0: Prep & security review (Redwood: Marissa / Orion: Jordan) — SSO config, control plane access, SOC2 evidence transfer. Target: 2026-09-10
- Phase 1: Integration sprint (Redwood: Karthik / Orion: Eng lead TBD) — API integration, test dataset pass, KV cache expectations. Target: 2026-09-30
- Phase 2: Performance validation (Redwood: Ben / Orion: Eng QA) — latency load profile, quantization test, baseline cost per 1M tokens. Target: 2026-10-15
- Phase 3: Production cutover & go-live (Redwood: Marissa / Orion: Ops) — runbook, rollback steps, SLA onboarding. Target: 2026-10-30

Quick notes / open items (in the sheet):
- Procurement/contract milestones are placeholders until we receive any redlines (cc procurement).
- Support coverage during cutover — we recommend a 72-hour on-call window from Redwood (Ben) and an Orion on-call lead.
- Risk heatmap included in the 'notes' tab.

Next steps I propose:
1) You and your PMO review the attached and confirm owners for Orion rows by EOD Friday (2026-09-04).
2) Procurement to circulate redlines; if none, we request PO by 2026-09-20 to keep the calendar.
3) We’ll set a 30-min cadence weekly for the next 6 weeks (Wednesdays 10am PT) starting 2026-09-09.

If that works I’ll convert the draft to a shared tracker in Drive and publish a compact playbook PDF.

Thanks — attaching the draft for review.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference — Production-first LLM inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Execution scorecard: MAP, milestones & owner commitments (draft)

Looping in a couple of resource notes from infra/testing:
- I'll own the performance validation (Phase 2) and will need a sample production load trace (preferably late-Aug or Sept timeframe) to set baselines. Jordan, can you drop a CSV or share a redacted trace?
- Karthik — can you confirm whether we need Dedicated GPU on day 1 or if we should stage on Hosted API first? That decision impacts schedule (quantization + kernel selection windows).

Short reply to the asks: monthly licensing terms will be included in the contract doc (Marissa, I can help sync with procurement). Also +1 on the weekly cadence.

-Ben

From: Procurement Team <procure@orionlabs.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Execution scorecard: MAP, milestones & owner commitments (draft)
Attachments: Orion_PO_terms_redlines.pdf (application/pdf)

Marissa,

See attached redlines to the MSA and the PO timing expectations. Two items that will affect milestone gating:
1) Data residency clause — Orion legal requests explicit EMEA data segregation for analytics logs (we flagged this in the redline).
2) Payment terms — standard 60-day net for new vendor; if Redwood requires <30 days we need to escalate for approval.

Requested timeline from procurement:
- Redline review complete: 2026-09-10
- Final MSA signoff: 2026-09-20
- PO issued: 2026-09-24 (to support the Sep->Oct sprint cadence)

If the legal items are material, that will push the Phase 0 acceptance dates — please advise on the impact.

Thanks,
Orion Procurement Team
procure@orionlabs.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Reeves <jordan.reeves@orionlabs.com>, Procurement Team <procure@orionlabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 15:43:00 -07:00
Subject: FINAL: Execution scorecard & commitments — updated with legal notes and confirmed owners
Attachments: Execution_Scorecard_v1.pdf (application/pdf)

Jordan / Procurement —

Thanks for the quick turnaround on feedback. I've consolidated the redlines and updated the execution scorecard (attached PDF) and the shared Drive tracker: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMAPdraft. Key updates below (action required items in bold):

- Data residency clause: Redwood can segregate analytics logs to the US region by default; EMEA segregation is possible but will add a 2-week config window (impact: Phase 0 target moves from 2026-09-10 to 2026-09-24). **Procurement/Legal: confirm whether EMEA segregation is required.**
- Procurement timeline: agreed target for PO issuance is 2026-09-24. **Procurement: please confirm PO issuance by 2026-09-20 at the latest.**
- Owners confirmed: Marissa (overall), Karthik (integration lead), Ben (performance & cutover), Monica (customer training & docs). Jordan to assign an Orion engineering lead by 2026-09-04.
- Go-live window: tentatively 2026-10-30; will firm once PO and data residency are confirmed.

Next steps I will do this week:
1) Publish the tracker as a shared Google Sheet and invite Orion leads.
2) Schedule the weekly 30-min checkpoints (Wednesdays 10am PT) starting 2026-09-09 and send calendar invites.
3) Prepare the cutover runbook draft for review by 2026-10-10.

If we get procurement confirmation on the PO and the data residency decision this week, we stay on the proposed 90-day runway. Otherwise we will need to rebaseline the map and I'll circulate a revised schedule.

Regards,

Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
